transcript.text: indesit oven stoped heating, fan goes round n light on but its stone cold after 20 mins. grill werks fine tho. any ideas b4 i call some1 out

Yes — because the grill still heats, the supply is at least partly present. With the oven fan and light working but no heat, the most likely cause is the fan-oven heating element or its wiring; the next possibilities are the function selector/thermostat control, or simply the clock being in automatic mode after a power cut. Before calling anyone, check that the clock is set to manual (often a hand symbol; a flashing clock or AUTO can inhibit heating) and that the function knob is on the fan-in-a-circle heating symbol, not fan-only/defrost. Set it to 180°C for 15 minutes after that. Is the clock flashing or showing AUTO, and is it most likely on the fan-oven setting?
clock isnt flashing, its in manual. knob is on the fan oven symbol. the orange light comes on n stays on but no heat. also heard a small pop from inside near the back last time it worked

The orange light staying on means it is still calling for heat, but it cannot prove whether the fault is the element itself or its connection. With the oven switched off at the cooker isolator/unplugged and fully cold, remove the shelves and use a torch to look at the circular element around the rear fan cover. Look only for an obvious split, blister, burn mark or melted-looking area; do not remove covers or touch wiring. If you can see damage, stop using the fan-oven function and arrange an engineer to check the fan-oven element and inspect its terminals. If it looks intact, the same symptoms can still be an element fault, but burnt wiring or the selector/control then need checking by an engineer.
ok isolated it at the cooker switch n let it go cold. theres a blister/split in the coil near the bottom with a black mark on it. so is it the element then?

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning or hot-plastic smell, smoke, scorching or melting can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't run it again — not even as a test — until it has been checked by a qualified engineer. The fan-oven function must not be used again until a qualified engineer has checked it; they should also inspect the element terminals for heat damage before fitting a replacement. The grill working does not rule this out, as it uses a separate heating circuit. If you can, send the full model number from the rating label around the oven-door opening; that identifies the correct element, but it can wait if the label is not accessible.
